title: GMGN.ai Solana Smart Money Integration
task: Integrate GMGN.ai API into wallet_monitor.py for real-time Solana Smart Money copy-trading, replacing raw Helius RPC polling with richer GMGN data

what_happened.initial_state: wallet_monitor.py used raw Helius RPC (getSignaturesForAddress + getTransaction) for Solana polling — returned buy_value_usd=0.0 always (no USD pricing info), UNKNOWN symbol, required DexScreener enrichment pass
what_happened.final_state: GMGN-first polling with Helius fallback. GMGN returns token symbol, name, USD cost, and direction pre-parsed. No separate enrichment pass needed for USD value on GMGN-sourced signals.

key_bugs_resolved.root_cause: Wrong base URL used: gmgn.ai (frontend CDN) instead of openapi.gmgn.ai (API gateway)

key_bugs_resolved.bug: GMGN API rejection from Hetzner VPS
key_bugs_resolved.root_cause: Hetzner VPS resolves openapi.gmgn.ai to its IPv6 address. GMGN explicitly rejects IPv6 connections at the WAF level (returns 403/empty body).
key_bugs_resolved.fix: Global urllib3 socket monkeypatch in GMGNClient.__init__: override socket.getaddrinfo to force AF_INET (IPv4) only. Applied before any requests are made.
key_bugs_resolved.code_pattern: orig = socket.getaddrinfo; socket.getaddrinfo = lambda *a, **kw: [x for x in orig(*a, **kw) if x[0] == socket.AF_INET]
key_bugs_resolved.note: This is a VPS-level networking quirk, not a code bug. Any future Hetzner VPS deployment should apply this patch for IPv6-hostile APIs.

key_bugs_resolved.root_cause: Raw Helius RPC returns token balance deltas but no USD pricing. buy_value_usd was hard-coded to 0.0, requiring a separate DexScreener enrichment pass.
key_bugs_resolved.fix: Replaced Helius-only logic with GMGN-first strategy. GMGN get_wallet_activity() returns cost_usd / value_usd per swap directly. Helius retained as fallback.

smart_money_audit_results.removal_reason: Wallet-3 had $0 PnL and 0% win rate — confirmed dead wallet

what_went_well: GMGN Ed25519 signing (sub_path:sorted_qs:body:timestamp) worked correctly first try once gateway URL was fixed
IPv4 monkeypatch is clean — applies globally at client init, no per-request overhead
GMGNClient is lazy-loaded in wallet_monitor — no import cost if GMGN not configured
Live audit correctly identified dead wallet in under 60 seconds
Dashboard now shows real PnL/win-rate data from GMGN — no static placeholders
what_went_wrong: Initially pointed at gmgn.ai (frontend) instead of openapi.gmgn.ai (API) — 3 failed attempts before identifying correct gateway
IPv6 rejection was silent: GMGN returns 403 with empty body, easy to misdiagnose as auth failure

deployment.method: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
deployment.verification: docker exec shamrock-bot python3 -c '...' confirmed WR=100%, PnL=$389K live
